Remote. I'll be collaborating with a team in Berlin.
What about the time zone?
It's four hours behind, so by the time they start, I'll have finished half my work.

Maybe. And home is full of distractions. I'll need discipline.
Many studies say productivity goes up at home.
I hope so. The company is sending me all the equipment, so I can be efficient from day one.

text: Do you know how penicillin was discovered? Wasn't it an accident? Partly. Alexander Fleming had been studying bacteria in his laboratory for years. What happened? He had been working on an experiment before his holiday, and he accidentally left some dishes open. And when he came back? He observed that a mould had killed the bacteria. He checked it under a microscope. So a mistake became a breakthrough! Yes. But the discovery only mattered because of his research. Other scientists had been testing his theory for ten years before the medicine was ready.

text: I have to give a speech at my sister's wedding, and I'm really nervous. That's normal. Not only beginners but also famous speakers feel anxiety. How can I feel more confident?
